source.variationPolicy: Use a Java-compatible Random with seed 0x47524e31 and preserve APK row scan order to select per-cell variations. The APK seeds this shared generator from currentTimeMillis, so web output is reproducible and does not claim to match every original launch.
source.scope: Original TDM grid and APK-derived Oregon background and street draw commands; scene objects, routes, and campaign rules are supplied by separate content modules.
